scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,passenger,driver,admin -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @ride-app/api" "npm run dev -w @ride-app/passenger" "npm run dev -w @ride-app/driver" "npm run dev -w @ride-app/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ride-app/shared && npm run build -w @ride-app/api && npm run build -w @ride-app/passenger && npm run build -w @ride-app/driver && npm run build -w @ride-app/admin
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.pm2:stop: pm2 stop ride-api ride-passenger ride-driver ride-admin
scripts.pm2:restart: pm2 restart ride-api ride-passenger ride-driver ride-admin
scripts.pm2:logs: pm2 logs ride-api ride-passenger ride-driver ride-admin
scripts.health: curl -sf http://localhost:4001/health && echo ' API ok' && curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:5174 && echo ' Passenger ok' && curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:5175 && echo ' Driver ok' && curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:5176 && echo ' Admin ok'
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ride-app/shared && npm run test -w @ride-app/api
